digest.component_or_area: MCP model schema generation and drift detection
propositions: BridgeFsckOut model declares three properties but bridge_fsck.schema.json declares four, missing binding_drift field that _engine_support/bridge_fsck.py emits unconditionally
VerifySignatureResultOut makes algorithm, head_sha, and key_id optional while the schema requires all three as non-optional
_mcp_models.py hand-mirrors five committed JSON schemas without any generator or drift gate, causing schema divergence to ship undetected
Tests referenced in _mcp_models.py comment as enforcing schema pinning do not exist (zero test hits for BridgeFsckOut, GroundingInfoOut, WorkflowRunOut), leaving false assurance of enforcement
MCP model layer has no equivalent to the TypedDict layer's automated drift check via gen_types.py --check that CI enforces
